title: Suzhou Institute of Nano-Tech and Nano-Bionics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content: Aerogel Research Institute. Suzhou Institute of Nano-Tech and Nano-Bionics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, is a national research institute focused on nanomaterials, nanotechnology, and related advanced materials. Its official research coverage includes colloidal aerogels and related nanoscale materials, making it relevant for aerogel formulation, characterization, and collaborative R&D.
